title: Riso Lane PY — Python template payload

questions.prompt: When this goal is executed via /goal, what is the primary mission?
questions.description: Lane ownership is already locked to template/files/python/**. This picks the first-wave intent for agents working the lane.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Baseline health + gate correctness: validate Jinja/feature gates against existing answers, fix payload bugs inside python/, and leave COORD handoffs for any contract gaps. No new features unless they unblock correctness.

options.label: Health + gates first
options.description: Audit/fix Jinja, feature gates, deps, and tests under python/ so renders stay correct for existing answer combos.

options.label: Harden all PY surfaces
options.description: Broader pass across API, CLI, MCP, GraphQL/WS, Sphinx docs, quality config, and shipped tests—still no contract edits.

options.label: Targeted feature work
options.description: Execute specific improvements you name (still exclusive to template/files/python/**).

questions.prompt: Within template/files/python/, which surfaces should get priority if time is limited?
questions.description: Tree today: pyproject/just/Makefile/ruff; src/{{package}}/{api,cli,codegen,graphql_api,websocket}; mcp/; docs/ (Sphinx); release/; tasks/; tests/. Copier _exclude for whole-tree/subpath gates lives in COORD-owned copier.yml—PY only owns in-file Jinja gates.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Prioritize: (1) pyproject + task runners + quality config, (2) FastAPI api/, (3) Typer cli/, (4) FastMCP mcp/, (5) GraphQL + WebSocket when api_features enable them, (6) Sphinx docs/, (7) shipped tests/. Codegen stays in-scope but lower priority unless broken.

options.label: Packaging + quality
options.description: pyproject.toml.jinja, justfile/Makefile, ruff, coverage, tasks/

options.label: FastAPI (api/)
options.description: REST app factory, routes, middleware, config

options.label: Typer CLI (cli/)
options.description: CLI commands, core, plugins

options.label: FastMCP (mcp/)
options.description: Python MCP server, tools, resources, prompts

options.label: GraphQL + WebSocket
options.description: graphql_api/, websocket/, api/websocket_endpoints — gated by api_features / legacy keys

options.label: Sphinx/Shibuya docs
options.description: python/docs/ when docs_framework=sphinx-shibuya

options.label: Shipped tests
options.description: python/tests/ rendered into consumer projects

options.label: Codegen module
options.description: src/{{package}}/codegen/ and related tests

options.label: Release helpers
options.description: python/release/ (changelog helpers when changelog_module enabled)

questions.prompt: How deep should verification go before calling the lane done?
questions.description: Hard rules still apply: no hand-edit of samples/*/render/; uv run only; no commits unless asked. Sample answers are PLATFORM-owned.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Standard lane bar: validate_jinja_templates.py (when available) + riso validate --json on python-heavy samples (api-python, docs-sphinx, changelog-python, full-stack as relevant) + narrowest maintainer pytest if it covers python payload. Do not require full sample re-render unless PLATFORM is co-running.

options.label: Jinja syntax only
options.description: validate_jinja_templates.py (or equivalent static checks) only

options.label: Jinja + riso validate + narrow pytest
options.description: Recommended: static Jinja + answer-file validate on python-heavy samples + targeted tests

options.label: Include sample re-render smoke
options.description: Also run render scripts for python-heavy variants (still no hand-edits of render/). Coordinates with PLATFORM.

questions.prompt: Where and how should COORD handoffs for missing keys/defaults/hooks be recorded?
questions.description: PY must not invent Copier keys or edit copier.yml, hooks, macros, or module_catalog. Handoffs are the only path for contract changes.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Write COORD handoff notes under goals/riso-lane-py/handoffs/ as markdown files (one topic per file or a running HANDOFFS.md), with: missing key/default/when/hook need, why PY needs it, proposed contract change (non-binding), and which python files would consume it. Never apply the contract change from this lane.

options.label: goals/riso-lane-py/handoffs/
options.description: Markdown handoffs in this goal package (recommended for multi-agent waves)

options.label: Plan section only
options.description: List handoffs only in plan.md / goal execution notes; no separate handoff files

options.label: Shared COORD inbox
options.description: goals/riso-lane-coord/inbox/ (or similar) if COORD goal owns a shared queue

questions.prompt: Confirm out-of-scope boundaries (anything to pull in or push out)?
questions.description: Default out of scope: Node/Fumadocs/Docusaurus, node/saas, Go/Rust, Electron/Tauri, frontend, quality/testing trees outside python/, src/riso CLI, web/, sample answers/render, and all COORD contract files. In-file Jinja gates under python/ stay in-scope; copier.yml _exclude rules stay COORD-owned.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Keep defaults: exclusive write template/files/python/** only. QUAL/PLATFORM/COORD stay out of write scope. Reading copier/hooks/samples/tests/docs/scripts is OK. If a fix needs _exclude or a new answer key, hand off to COORD rather than expanding PY ownership.

options.label: Keep stated boundaries
options.description: No expansion of write ownership or contract files

options.label: Explicitly allow reading QUAL templates
options.description: Read template/files/quality/** and testing/** for parity only; still no writes

options.label: Custom exception (describe)
options.description: Name a temporary exception if you need one
